parameters.description: personal shows the actor's tickets. list returns all project tickets, independent of dates/sprints. calendar returns open, non-Cancelled project tickets overlapping an inclusive date range, or undated work. list/calendar require project_id and project access; sprint_id is refused.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Single inclusive calendar day; either single date appears on its own day, and spans include both boundaries.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Inclusive calendar range start. Matches start <= range end and due >= range start, coalescing either missing date to the other.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Inclusive calendar range end; must not precede start_date.

parameters.name: undated
parameters.description: calendar only: return open tickets with neither date instead of the range.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Case-insensitive literal ticket-key substring.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Case-insensitive literal title substring.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Project workflow-state key.

parameters.name: assignee
parameters.description: User ID, me, or unassigned. list/calendar match the actual assignee, not the reporter.

parameters.name: start_on
parameters.description: Exact start-date filter.

parameters.name: due_on
parameters.description: Exact due-date filter.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: list only. Priority ascending is high-first. Nulls always last; ID breaks ties.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: list/calendar only. Pages contain at most 500 tickets; advance by returned count while pagination.hasMore is true.

403.description: ACCESS_DENIED, WORKLOG_CANCELLED or WORKLOG_FOR_OTHERS_DENIED: the viewer cannot log work or supplied an author without the behalf capability.

post.description: Logs the viewer’s work, or a same-org author for this ticket project’s admin or an org admin (HR admin and above); done tickets are allowed. Project members and viewers cannot log for others. Archived projects refuse writes. Author and original logged-by are separate. History and audit are transactional; task_updated is emitted after commit. Attendance warnings are computed after saving against the saved author and day; failed checks never block or roll back the write. Remaining mode auto/set/leave applies in the same transaction; set requires remaining_estimate (empty clears).

400.description: INVALID_WORKLOG: unsupported fields. INVALID_ESTIMATE for invalid remaining choices.

403.description: ACCESS_DENIED: only the author, this ticket project’s admin or an org admin can delete a writable worklog.

404.description: Ticket or active worklog not found in this organization/ticket.

delete.description: The author, this ticket project’s admin or an org admin can delete a visible worklog; project-role and archive guards still apply. Excluded from time spent and daily totals; preserved in history. Audit/history are transactional; task_updated is sent after commit. Remaining estimate choices are supported. Remaining mode auto/set/leave applies in the same transaction; set requires remaining_estimate (empty clears).

400.description: INVALID_DURATION or INVALID_WORKLOG; nothing is changed. INVALID_ESTIMATE for invalid remaining choices.

403.description: ACCESS_DENIED or WORKLOG_FOR_OTHERS_DENIED: only the author, this ticket project’s admin or an org admin can correct a writable worklog; any supplied author requires the behalf capability.

404.description: Ticket or active worklog not found in this organization/ticket.

patch.description: Accepts changed day worked, duration, start time, comment or author_id. Null clears start time/comment. The author, this ticket project’s admin or an org admin may edit; project-role and archive guards still apply. Changing author requires can.logWorkForOthers and keeps original logged-by. Done and Cancelled retain corrections. History/audit commit atomically and task_updated is sent after commit. Attendance warnings are recomputed after saving against the saved author/day and updated aggregate; failed checks never block or roll back corrections. Remaining mode auto/set/leave applies in the same transaction; set requires remaining_estimate (empty clears).
